events.title: ONEOK to Acquire Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin Assets for $4.425 Billion
events.summary: ONEOK, Inc. is acquiring Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin natural gas gathering and processing assets for $4.425 billion. The acquisition will be funded by a $9 billion nonvoting minority equity investment from Apollo funds, with $5 billion of the proceeds used to reduce ONEOK's existing debt. This strategic move is expected to accelerate deleveraging, enhance capital allocation flexibility, and be immediately accretive to earnings and free cash flow per share.

events.title: ONEOK to Acquire Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin Assets for $4.425 Billion
events.summary: ONEOK, Inc. announced a definitive agreement to acquire Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin assets for $4.425 billion. This acquisition will be funded by a $9 billion nonvoting minority equity investment from Apollo funds, with $5 billion used to reduce ONEOK's existing debt. The deal is expected to be immediately accretive to earnings and free cash flow per share, accelerating ONEOK's deleveraging and growth in the Permian Midland Basin.

events.title: ExxonMobil Corporation $XOM Shares Bought by Flputnam Investment Management Co.
events.summary: Flputnam Investment Management Co. significantly increased its stake in ExxonMobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) by 30.5% in the second quarter, bringing its total holdings to 114,111 shares valued at $15.6 million. This move is part of a broader trend of institutional investors and hedge funds owning a substantial 61.8% of XOM. Despite a slight earnings per share miss, ExxonMobil reported strong quarterly revenue and declared a $1.03 dividend, maintaining a "Hold" consensus rating from analysts with an average price target of $166.10.

events.title: ExxonMobil Corporation $XOM Stake Reduced by UBS AM a distinct business unit of UBS ASSET MANAGEMENT AMERICAS LLC
events.summary: UBS Asset Management significantly reduced its stake in ExxonMobil Corporation (XOM) by 30.7% in the second quarter of 2026, selling over 4.8 million shares but still holding a substantial position valued at approximately $1.5 billion. Despite this reduction, institutional investors collectively own a majority of XOM stock. ExxonMobil reported Q2 earnings slightly below consensus but revenue exceeded expectations, and the company declared a quarterly dividend of $1.03 per share, yielding 2.6%.

events.title: Cullinan Associates Inc. Sells 15,408 Shares of ExxonMobil Corporation $XOM
events.summary: Cullinan Associates Inc. reduced its stake in ExxonMobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) by 6.8% in the second quarter, selling 15,408 shares but still retaining 210,525 shares valued at $28.8 million. Despite this, institutional investors collectively own 61.8% of XOM. Analyst sentiment for ExxonMobil is mixed, resulting in a consensus "Hold" rating with an average price target of $166.10, while the company reported revenue above estimates but slightly missed EPS expectations.

events.title: Oneok Bets $4.425 Billion on Brazos Assets To Expand Permian Operations
events.summary: Oneok, Inc. is acquiring Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin assets for $4.425 billion, aiming to significantly expand its natural gas gathering and processing capacity in the region. The deal will be financed by a $9 billion nonvoting minority equity investment from Apollo, with $5 billion used to reduce ONEOK's debt. This acquisition is expected to strengthen ONEOK's Permian-to-Gulf Coast strategy, improve earnings, and accelerate deleveraging, boosting its position in a key U.S. production area.

events.title: Chevron and Exxon Mobil Rise 3% as U.S. Strikes on Iran Push WTI Crude Oil to $86
events.summary: Shares of Chevron and Exxon Mobil rose 3% following U.S. military strikes on Iran over the weekend, which led to WTI crude oil climbing above $86 per barrel due to ongoing constraints in shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. While these geopolitical events provided a short-term boost to energy stocks like XLE, analysts caution that the significant year-to-date gains of Chevron (36%) and Exxon Mobil (33%) leave limited buffer if the geopolitical risk premium quickly reverses. Investors are advised to monitor Hormuz traffic and OPEC's response, as the current price surge is primarily driven by headline risk and may not reflect long-term earnings power.

events.title: Summit Greenlights Double E Compression Project as Permian Demand Grows
events.summary: Summit Midstream has approved the Double E Compression expansion project, costing an estimated $100 million net to Summit's 70% ownership stake. An affiliate of ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. owns the remaining 30%. This expansion is in response to growing demand in the Permian Basin.

events.title: ConocoPhillips Considers Selling Permian Assets Worth $2 Billion, Bloomberg News Reports
events.summary: ConocoPhillips is reportedly exploring the sale of some of its Permian Basin assets, which could fetch around $2 billion, as part of an effort to streamline its portfolio. The company is working with advisors to find a buyer, with interest expected from strategic and private equity suitors. This move follows ConocoPhillips' announcement of $3.2 billion in asset sales in 2025, as it aims to reach a $5 billion disposition target by the end of 2026.

events.title: DTE Energy Co stock hits 52-week low at 19.11 USD
events.summary: DTE Energy Co's preferred stock, Series E, has hit a 52-week low of 19.11 USD, representing a 17% drop from its 52-week high. This decline reflects a challenging year for the company, with a one-year total return of -10.44% and a -11.26% decrease over the past six months, underscoring broader market pressures and sector-specific challenges. Stakeholders are expected to monitor strategic adjustments to address this downward trend.

events.title: Chevron and Halliburton Near Billion-Dollar Venezuela Oil Deals
events.summary: Chevron and Halliburton are reportedly close to striking multi-billion dollar oil deals in Venezuela, driven by the Trump administration's push to rebuild the country's oil sector. Chevron aims to expand its heavy-oil field portfolio, while Halliburton is negotiating to supply equipment and services. This development signals a significant U.S. re-engagement with Venezuela's oil industry, despite concerns from companies like ExxonMobil and ConocoPhillips regarding past nationalizations.

events.title: EP Stock Jumps 16% as Q2 Loss Narrows, Revenues Rise Y/Y
events.summary: Empire Petroleum Corporation (EP) shares rose 16.2% following its Q2 2026 earnings report, where the company's net loss narrowed by 63% and product revenues increased by 27% year-over-year. Despite a decrease in average daily equivalent sales, the company saw improved adjusted EBITDA and expects increased activity in Texas and Louisiana, with a resolution concerning New Mexico residual-oil-zone rights also anticipated. The company acquired a 25% working interest in a Louisiana development program and completed regulatory procedures for North Dakota property interests.

events.title: ONEOK to expand Permian basin footprint with $4.425 billion deal with Brazos Midstream
events.summary: ONEOK Inc. has agreed to acquire Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland basin natural gas gathering and processing assets for $4.425 billion, significantly expanding its footprint in the region. This acquisition will more than double ONEOK's Midland basin processing capacity to about 2.3 bcfd and integrate its natural gas and NGL systems. The deal is funded by a $9 billion nonvoting minority equity investment from Apollo and affiliates, with ONEOK using $5 billion to reduce debt.

events.title: ONEOK (OKE) Doubles Down on the Permian with $4.43 Billion Brazos Acquisition
events.summary: ONEOK (OKE) is acquiring Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin natural gas assets for $4.425 billion, significantly expanding its processing capacity. This deal is partially funded by a $9 billion nonvoting equity investment from Apollo, allowing ONEOK to reduce debt and avoid common-share issuance. While the acquisition is expected to be immediately accretive to earnings and free cash flow and strengthen ONEOK's Permian position, potential risks include integration challenges, concentration in the Permian, and Apollo's claim on future cash flows.

events.title: Chevron and Halliburton Near Billion-Dollar Venezuela Oil Deals
events.summary: Chevron (CVX) and Halliburton (HAL) are reportedly close to striking deals that could inject billions of dollars into Venezuela's oil industry, with Chevron potentially expanding its heavy-oil fields and Halliburton aiming to supply oilfield services. These moves align with the Trump administration's efforts to revive Venezuela's oil sector and secure crude supplies for the U.S. While ExxonMobil and ConocoPhillips remain cautious due to past nationalizations, these potential agreements could reshape Venezuela's oil landscape, though uncertainties regarding capital, infrastructure, and political complexities persist.

events.title: Headlands Technologies LLC Grows Stake in ExxonMobil Corporation $XOM
events.summary: Headlands Technologies LLC significantly increased its stake in ExxonMobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) by 1,399.3% in the second quarter, now holding 19,866 shares valued at $2.7 million. Despite mixed analyst ratings, with an average "Hold" and a $166.10 price target, ExxonMobil reported strong quarterly revenue of $114.53 billion and declared a $1.03 quarterly dividend. Institutional investors collectively own 61.8% of the company.

events.title: Quantitative Investment Management LLC Makes New Investment in ExxonMobil Corporation $XOM
events.summary: Quantitative Investment Management LLC has made a new investment in ExxonMobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM), purchasing 123,394 shares valued at approximately $16.87 million, making it their sixth-largest holding. Institutional investors collectively own 61.8% of the company, with several other large investors also adjusting their positions. Analyst sentiment is mixed, resulting in a consensus "Hold" rating and a $166.10 price target, despite the company exceeding revenue expectations but slightly missing EPS forecasts in its last quarterly report.

events.title: Summit Midstream makes FID on Double E Pipeline mainline expansion
events.summary: Summit Midstream has made a final investment decision (FID) to expand the Double E Pipeline through a mainline compression project, expected to be operational in Q4 2028. This expansion will increase the pipeline's forward haul capacity to the Waha Hub by approximately 900 million cubic feet per day and is supported by a new long-term transportation agreement with an investment-grade shipper. The project, costing about $100 million, will be funded primarily by Summit Midstream and a subsidiary of ExxonMobil, pending regulatory approvals.

events.title: Why Are XOM, CVX, GEV Stocks Rising Overnight?
events.summary: Shares of Exxon Mobil Corp. (XOM), Chevron Corp. (CVX), and GE Vernova Inc. (GEV) rose after reports indicated they are set to sign major energy deals in Venezuela. These agreements are part of a six-month migration of oil contracts to an amended hydrocarbon law, offering foreign firms more flexibility. Former President Trump also confirmed potential involvement of these companies in a "BIGGEST OIL DEAL IN HISTORY" with Venezuela.

events.title: Today’s News: Iran Strikes, Grand Canyon Floods and a New Era at Apple
events.summary: This article covers major global and national news, including renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities threatening oil prices, a leadership change at Apple with John Ternus succeeding Tim Cook, and ongoing search efforts after floods in the Grand Canyon and Nepal. It also highlights the Massachusetts Democratic Senate primary and Hurricane Karina.

events.title: Summit Midstream Corporation Announces Final Investment Decision on Double E Pipeline Mainline Compression Expansion
events.summary: Summit Midstream Corporation announced a final investment decision for the Double E Pipeline's mainline compression expansion, backed by a new long-term firm transportation agreement with an investment-grade shipper for 200 MMcf/d. This expansion will increase the pipeline's forward haul capacity to Waha by approximately 900 MMcf/d and is expected to be in service by Q4 2028. The project, costing about $100 million net to Summit's 70% interest, is fully funded through committed financing, and management anticipates significant growth in Permian Segment Adjusted EBITDA by 2030.

events.title: Sasol Confirms Continued Disruption at Key South African Refinery
events.summary: Sasol has confirmed ongoing disruptions at its Natref refinery in South Africa due to an unplanned shutdown of one unit coinciding with a planned shutdown of another. Despite these issues, Natref has implemented measures to maintain operations until the end of September to ensure stable jet fuel supply, especially to OR Tambo International Airport. The company reported increased production from Natref and Secunda in its latest financial results, contributing to higher annual fuel sales and improved earnings.

events.title: Mufg Securities Canada LTD. Sells 10,306 Shares of Imperial Oil Limited $IMO
events.summary: Mufg Securities Canada LTD. has decreased its stake in Imperial Oil Limited by 4.6%, selling 10,306 shares and retaining 212,062 shares valued at approximately $23.8 million. Despite institutional investors collectively owning 20.74% of the company, analysts maintain a "Strong Sell" rating with a price target of $116, contrasting with the stock's current $131.34. Imperial Oil reported strong quarterly results, beating earnings and revenue estimates, and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.87 per share.

events.title: Angolan oil company takes Chevron’s $260 million deal from London bidder using partner rights
events.summary: An Angolan oil company, Etu Energias, has acquired Chevron's $260 million offshore asset sale in Blocks 14 and 14K, leveraging its pre-emption rights as an existing partner. This move prevented London-listed Energean from entering the producing blocks. Etu Energias, a privately owned Angolan company, is set to become the majority owner and operator of Block 14, marking a significant step towards local control in Angola's oil sector.

events.title: Proficio Capital Partners LLC Purchases 14,786 Shares of ExxonMobil Corporation $XOM
events.summary: Proficio Capital Partners LLC significantly increased its stake in ExxonMobil Corporation by 269.7% in the second quarter, acquiring 14,786 additional shares and bringing its total holdings to 20,268 shares valued at $2.77 million. Other institutional investors have also adjusted their positions in the company, which maintains a significant 61.8% institutional ownership. Despite mixed analyst sentiment and a consensus "Hold" rating, ExxonMobil reported strong quarterly revenue and a consistent dividend, with its stock performing positively recently.

events.title: Assurant Inc stock hits 52-week low at 18.26 USD By Investing.com
events.summary: Assurant Inc. (AIZN) stock has fallen to a 52-week low of $18.26, representing a 9.84% decline over the past year. Despite this, the company has a market cap of $13.9 billion, a P/E ratio of 13.87, and reported revenue growth of 9.36% in Q2 2026, earning a "GREAT" financial health score from InvestingPro. The recent low highlights challenges in the broader insurance sector and market conditions.

events.title: HCA Healthcare (HCA) Navigates Patient Volume Challenges While Reporting Growth
events.summary: HCA Healthcare, Inc. (HCA) faces patient volume challenges despite reporting sales and profit growth, as highlighted in First Eagle Global Fund's Q2 2026 investor letter. The fund noted declines in respiratory-related emergency room visits, inpatient, and outpatient surgeries, alongside decreased enrollment in Medicaid and Affordable Care Act exchanges. Despite these headwinds, First Eagle Global Fund maintains confidence in HCA's management, citing effective operations and balance sheet stewardship, including capital returns to shareholders through share buybacks.

events.title: Baytex Energy Stock Rises 2.28% as Oil Exposure, Production Scale and Free Cash Flow Support Momentum
events.summary: Baytex Energy Corp. (TSX:BTE) saw its stock rise by 2.28% due to improved investor sentiment towards oil producers, driven by its diversified oil-production platform, strong drilling inventory, and ability to generate free cash flow. The company benefits from exposure to both Canadian and U.S. oil-producing regions, providing a broader asset mix and multiple sources of cash generation. While the recent gain is positive, sustained upside will depend on production execution, commodity prices, operating costs, and continued balance-sheet discipline.

events.title: Vermilion Energy Stock Rises 2.36% as Global Energy Exposure and Free Cash Flow Support Momentum
events.summary: Vermilion Energy Inc. (TSX:VET) saw its stock rise by 2.36%, reflecting investor interest in its diversified oil and natural gas portfolio, international pricing exposure, and strong free cash flow generation potential. The company's unique exposure to European natural gas markets, alongside its North American assets, provides significant operational and pricing flexibility. While the positive session indicates improved sentiment, sustained upside depends on production performance, commodity prices, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet discipline.

events.title: ONEOK to Grow Midland Midstream Footprint with Brazos Acquisition
events.summary: ONEOK has agreed to acquire Brazos Midstream's natural gas gathering and processing assets in the Permian Basin for $4.425 billion in cash. This acquisition, supported by a $9 billion minority equity investment from Apollo Global Management, will more than double ONEOK's processing capacity in the Permian's Midland sub-basin. The deal is expected to accelerate ONEOK's adjusted EBITDA growth and enhance its financial flexibility.

events.title: Oil Stocks Don't Need to Double for This ETF to Explode. Here's How 2X Energy Leverage Works
events.summary: This article explains how the Direxion Daily Energy Bull 2X Shares (ERX) ETF works, providing 200% of the daily return of the Energy Select Sector Index. It highlights that sustained gains can lead to significant compounding, but also warns about the risks of volatility drag and how daily resetting leverage can erode capital during sideways or volatile markets. The article emphasizes that ERX is a powerful tool for amplifying returns in a clear, upward-trending market but requires careful consideration of both direction and market path.

events.title: People Forget Amazon’s $600 Billion E-Commerce Business Is Bigger Than Microsoft
events.summary: Amazon's e-commerce business is projected to exceed $750 billion this year, making it larger than Microsoft's total revenue and rivaling Exxon. While AWS is a significant contributor to Amazon's market cap, the e-commerce division's substantial revenue and growth rate are often overlooked by investors. The article suggests that breaking Amazon into two public companies could allow investors to choose between the stable e-commerce and high-growth AWS segments.

events.title: Marathon Petroleum (NYSE:MPC) SVP Sells $375,750.00 in Stock
events.summary: Marathon Petroleum (NYSE:MPC) SVP Shawn Lyon sold 1,000 shares of company stock for $375,750, reducing his overall holdings by 8.2%. This sale comes as MPC shares rose 2.3% to $382.08, nearing its 52-week high, following strong quarterly results that exceeded analyst expectations for both EPS and revenue. The company also declared a quarterly dividend of $1.00 per share and maintains a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts.

events.title: Shawn Lyon Sells 425 Shares of Marathon Petroleum (NYSE:MPC) Stock
events.summary: Marathon Petroleum (NYSE:MPC) SVP Shawn Lyon sold 425 shares of the company's stock for approximately $156,617, reducing his ownership by 3.37%. The sale occurred as MPC shares traded near a 52-week high, with the company reporting strong quarterly earnings that surpassed analyst expectations and declaring a $1.00 per share dividend. Despite the insider sale and an average analyst price target below the current trading price, institutional ownership remains high, and analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" consensus.

events.title: Ryder System EVP Robert D. Fatovic Gifts 403 Shares, Updates Ownership Stake
events.summary: Robert D. Fatovic, EVP, Chief Legal Officer, and Corporate Secretary of Ryder System Inc, gifted 403 shares of common stock on August 28, 2026. This transaction, recorded at no monetary exchange, updated his direct beneficial ownership to 88,455 shares. Fatovic also maintains indirect holdings through company savings and deferred compensation plans, with no changes to derivative securities.

events.title: CVX Stock Extends Gains Overnight: Chevron Reportedly Nears Deal For Giant Venezuelan Oil Fields
events.summary: Chevron (CVX) shares rose on reports that the company is close to securing a deal for two major oil fields in Venezuela's Orinoco Belt, significantly expanding its operations. This development follows an announcement by U.S. President Donald Trump about a new agreement with Venezuela to access substantial oil reserves, with Chevron's deal expected to be the largest among several forthcoming announcements. The move aims to encourage increased U.S. investment in Venezuela's oil sector, as retail sentiment for CVX stock has also turned "extremely bullish."

events.title: Chevron to Spend $7 Billion on Doubling Its Venezuelan Output
events.summary: Chevron plans to invest $7 billion over the next five years to more than double its oil production in Venezuela, marking the largest financial commitment to revive the country's oil industry since the US government's push began. The company expects to reach 600,000 barrels of oil per day by 2031 and has secured significant protections for its investments. This move leverages Venezuela's vast oil reserves and Chevron's long-standing presence in the country, despite past political challenges and sanctions.

events.title: Alyeska Investment Group L.P. Invests $5.98 Million in Marathon Petroleum Corporation $MPC
events.summary: Alyeska Investment Group L.P. has acquired a new stake worth approximately $5.98 million in Marathon Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:MPC) during the second quarter. This move is part of broader institutional interest, with 76.77% of Marathon Petroleum's stock now owned by institutional investors and hedge funds, despite some insider selling. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average target price of $315.06, reflecting positive sentiment driven by strong operating results and geopolitical factors boosting oil prices.

events.title: Aemetis Praises Unanimous Legislative Passage of California E15 Implementation Legislation
events.summary: Aemetis, Inc. lauded the unanimous passage of California Senate Bill 795, a legislative action that will enable fuel retailers to use existing vapor recovery equipment for E15 dispensing. This bill resolves previous equipment certification requirements that had delayed the implementation of E15, which was approved for year-round use in October 2025. According to Aemetis CEO Eric McAfee, this regulatory fix is crucial for opening California's market to American-made ethanol, potentially reducing fuel costs for consumers and increasing demand for ethanol by over 600 million gallons annually.

events.title: Wells Fargo raises Targa Resources price target on Exxon deal
events.summary: Wells Fargo has increased its price target for Targa Resources (TRGP) to $324 from $282, maintaining an Overweight rating, following Targa's 20-year agreements with ExxonMobil for integrated midstream services in the Permian Basin. This deal is expected to support a higher pace of infrastructure buildout and has led Wells Fargo to raise its 2028 and beyond EBITDA forecast. Separately, Targa Resources reported strong Q2 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.81, exceeding forecasts, and Raymond James also raised its price target for the company to $335.

events.title: Imperial Oil Limited (TSX:IMO) Gains 3.04% as Kearl Milestone, Strong Cash Generation and Oil-Market Momentum Lift Investor Optimism
events.summary: Imperial Oil Limited (TSX:IMO) saw its shares rise by 3.04% due to strong cash generation, a significant production milestone at its Kearl oil-sands operation, and positive oil-market momentum. The company maintains its dividend and accelerates its share-repurchase program, despite facing risks from crude price volatility and downstream operational issues. Imperial's integrated business model and financial strength are key attractions for investors, though ESG concerns related to oil-sands production remain relevant.

events.title: Chevron’s $7-billion Venezuela gamble aims to double oil output
events.summary: Chevron plans to invest $7 billion over the next five years in Venezuela through joint ventures to more than double its crude production in the country. This significant financial commitment follows Chevron securing rights to develop two major oil fields in the Orinoco Belt, aiming for a total output of 600,000 barrels per day by 2031. The move is part of a U.S. government-led initiative to revitalize Venezuela's oil industry, with Chevron leveraging its established presence in the country.

events.title: Exxon Mobil (XOM) Q1 2025 Earnings: Results, Market Reaction & History
events.summary: ExxonMobil reported mixed Q1 2025 results, beating EPS estimates with $1.76 per share but missing revenue forecasts at $83.13 billion. The company saw strong performance in its Upstream segment, boosted by the Pioneer acquisition, which offset weaker refining and chemical margins. ExxonMobil maintained its shareholder returns program and reiterated full-year capital expenditure guidance.

events.title: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth Highlights Two Factors Behind The $7B-Plus Venezuela Bet
events.summary: Chevron plans to invest over $7 billion in Venezuela in the next five years, aiming to more than double production by 2026 levels. CEO Mike Wirth attributes this decision to improved economic terms, which lower per-barrel costs, and stronger legal protections for investors. The move is supported by both the U.S. and Venezuelan governments and follows a reshaping of Venezuela's oil industry.

events.title: Patterson-UTI Energy stock hits 52-week high at 13.08 USD
events.summary: Patterson-UTI Energy Inc. (PTEN) stock has reached a 52-week high of $13.08, reflecting a 133% increase over the past year and significant momentum in recent months. The company's strong performance in the energy sector is supported by upward earnings revisions from analysts, a 3.13% dividend yield maintained for 23 consecutive years, and a 10% revenue increase in the second quarter. Piper Sandler reiterated an Overweight rating, indicating continued positive outlook for the company.

events.title: Matrix Announces Award for Front-End Engineering and Design on America First Refining Storage Tank Farm in Brownsville, Texas
events.summary: Matrix Service Company has been awarded the front-end engineering and design (FEED) for the storage tank farm of America First Refining's (AFR) new large-scale refinery in Brownsville, Texas. This project is a crucial step towards AFR's Final Investment Decision for what will be the first major refinery constructed in the U.S. in over 50 years, aimed at processing domestic crude and strengthening America's energy supply chain.
